supports: On this fixed TSLA pair, P2 is the clearest public read because it best links autonomy commercialization to trade-policy and incentive shocks.
Holding the tagged packet fixed shows that protocol framing alone changes whether the first read is a broad pivot or a sharper mechanism chain.
A matrix-first public case can teach policy shock and platform-roadmap dependence without requiring public outline compare.
The public value here is visible judgment about mechanism, not generic AI or EV-demand narration.
does_not_yet_support: This is not a benchmark-grade claim about all autonomy-heavy filings, all models, or all prompt families.
It does not prove that every autonomy mention deserves the same first-read prominence.
It does not justify shipping the manual-review-only outline-compare artifacts for TSLA in this pass.
why_02_is_hero: P2 stays first because it best surfaces the policy-shock and commercialization mechanism chain on the tagged evidence packet.
why_03_is_main_comparator: P1 uses the same tagged packet as P2, so the main variable is answer shape rather than evidence source.
why_00_is_control: P0 keeps the same tagged packet but shows what a simpler prompt does to specificity, prioritization, and stop discipline.
why_01_is_secondary: No separate 01 lane is shipped in this pass; the public matrix intentionally stops at P2, P1, and P0.
